# CRS Gas

CRS Gas is an LPG gas cylinder exchange, refill and delivery service serving Boksburg and surrounding areas in Gauteng, South Africa.

## Business

Name: CRS Gas
Website: https://crsgas.co.za/
Location: Boksburg and surrounding areas, Gauteng, South Africa
Phone: +27 82 212 5271
WhatsApp: https://wa.me/27671161984

## Services

CRS Gas provides:

- LPG gas cylinder exchanges
- LPG gas cylinder refills
- LPG gas cylinder delivery
- Household LPG gas supply
- Commercial LPG gas supply

## Cylinder sizes and prices

- 5kg LPG cylinder — R150
- 9kg LPG cylinder — R300
- 14kg LPG cylinder — R500
- 19kg LPG cylinder — R620
- 48kg LPG cylinder — R1450

## Delivery

Free delivery is advertised for Boksburg and surrounding areas. Customers should contact CRS Gas to confirm delivery availability for their specific suburb or address.

## Ordering

Customers can submit an order through the CRS Gas website or contact CRS Gas directly by WhatsApp or telephone.
